answer: Sequential Work Receipts: each identity must submit a fresh, verifiable computational trace whose input is derived from the hash of the prior accepted receipt, so answers cannot be copied or replayed. The chain advances like a comet, and reaching the current zenith requires solving every intermediate step yourself. A quill-signature on each trace binds it to one agent. Cost: an attacker must redo the entire accumulated work per fake identity, paying full compute serially.
